page_title: MAL 1-1 LEV | Mallorca v Levante 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Miguel Ortiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Jose Morales (Levante) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
90+4' Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) makes a slide tackle, but referee Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul. Mallorca win a free kick.
90+3' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+2' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
90' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
88' Julian Calero has decided to substitute Unai Vencedor and he is replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Martinez Andres trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
88' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
87' Ball possession – 63:37.
84' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Etta Eyong (Levante), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
84' A quickly taken corner by Levante.

83' Roger Brugue (Levante) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Levante have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
83' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Vedat Muriqi will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
83' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jan Virgili.

81' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Leo Roman pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
79' 1 - 1 A great first touch by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) as he blasts the ball from mid-range. The shot goes off the post into the top left corner.
76' A nice lofted cross finds Roger Brugue (Levante) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the bottom right post, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save!
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:6.
73' It is time for a substitution. Javier Llabres (Mallorca) is on for Samu Costa.
73' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Alvarez (Levante) replacing Victor Garcia.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dela (Levante) is coming onto the pitch as Jeremy Toljan cannot continue after picking up an injury.

70' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
70' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

69' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
67' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Ortiz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
64' Levante take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' Manu Sanchez (Levante) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Levante have a corner.
62' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
61' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Pablo Torre (Mallorca) replaces Sergi Darder.
59' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
58' Here comes a substitution. Roger Brugue (Levante) is brought on as a substitute for Goduine Koyalipou.
57' Mathew Ryan makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) after a cross from the side.
54' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.
52' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Levante will have an opportunity.
49' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) is booked for saying more than Miguel Ortiz was willing to tolerate.

48' A precise low pass is received by Samu Costa (Mallorca), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
48' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Levante comes to nothing.
45+5' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Levante force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+2' Miguel Ortiz shows the yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca) for a heavy challenge.
45+1' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

44' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Mathew Ryan anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the right side of the target. Mallorca earn a corner.
42' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Johan Mojica (Mallorca) but poses no threat.

39' Close! Sergi Darder (Mallorca) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
38' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
36' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

31' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Sergi Darder (Mallorca) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
30' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' A cross from Samu Costa (Mallorca) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Good work from Mallorca as they win a corner.
29' The ball falls kindly for Etta Eyong (Levante) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
28' Great save! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Mathew Ryan.
28' Mallorca work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
28' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.
27' A yellow card for a tackle by Sergi Darder (Mallorca). Miguel Ortiz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

24' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Jan Virgili, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
22' 0 - 1 Goal! Etta Eyong (Levante) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.

20' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
19' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' The possession of the ball – 64:36.
11' Unai Vencedor (Levante) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul after Johan Mojica (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
8' Mallorca are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
6' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
6' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
5' The game is interrupted now, Johan Mojica (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' Victor Garcia (Levante) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Today's referee will be Miguel Ortiz.
